_comment: OpenWorker MCP servers for the estimating platform.
The server KEY is what OpenWorker uses to namespace tools as mcp__<key>__<tool>
`auth: oauth` makes OpenWorker run browser OAuth 2.1 + PKCE with Dynamic Client
Registration (coworker/mcp/oauth.py); tokens land in the SecretStore, never here.
The plugin's third server, artifact-editor, is deliberately absent. Since
estimating_tools 0.1.8 it WOULD serve tools-only hosts (browser mode:
open_artifact_editor + collect_artifact_edits over loopback HTTP), so shipping it
here is a viable follow-up — see the README. Until that decision the skills use
Keys beginning with _ are ignored by install.py and never written.
